message.content: {"label":"youtube_header_bar","observations":["Top navigation bar of YouTube interface with dark theme","Left side features a hamburger menu button and the YouTube Premium logo with 'IN' region tag","Center features a search bar with placeholder 'Search' and a magnifying glass search submit button","Right of the search bar is a circular voice search button (microphone icon)","Right side features a '+ Create' pill button, a notification bell icon with a red '9+' badge, and a circular user profile avatar with letter 'H'"],"interpretations":["Main application header providing site-wide navigation, search, content creation, notification, and profile management functions."],"uncertainties":[],"children":[{"label":"menu_button","bbox":[18,347,40,653],"inspect":false,"reason":"Hamburger menu icon button to toggle navigation sidebar"},{"label":"youtube_logo","bbox":[78,289,207,702],"inspect":false,"reason":"YouTube Premium logo linking to home"},{"label":"search_bar","bbox":[277,140,711,851],"inspect":false,"reason":"Text input field and search button combination"},{"label":"voice_search_button","bbox":[736,140,776,851],"inspect":false,"reason":"Microphone button for voice query"},{"label":"create_button","bbox":[801,140,891,851],"inspect":false,"reason":"Create video or post button"},{"label":"notifications_button","bbox":[908,273,942,727],"inspect":false,"reason":"Bell icon for notification panel with unread badge"},{"label":"user_profile_avatar","bbox":[958,264,988,736],"inspect":false,"reason":"User account avatar button"}]}
